name: issues_label
description: Add one label to one issue on Ledgerline's tracker. RepoMind applies its triage label (bug, feature, question or docs), the same label its comment states. The result is JSON {label, issue, applied}; it is never empty when the label was added. Safe to retry: the harness keys every write, so a repeat returns the label already there. A label is at most 40 characters: lower-case letters, digits, and - _ / only.

issue.description: The issue to label, such as issue-4192.

label.description: One label, such as bug. At most 40 characters.

examples.note: the typical call: the triage label
a hard case: a documentation issue gets docs, not bug, even when something is broken
